WHERE IT’S FROM
Affalterbach, Germany, is an orchard town where trophies are
harvested. It’s the home of AMG, where for nearly 50 years,
championship racecars have been created by a team of people
who are not just racers. They’re dreamers. Visionaries. And
perfectionists. They develop technologies that heighten power,
like patented NANOSLIDE® cylinder walls that slash friction and
wear. They shatter limitations: Rear-biased AMG Performance
4matic® clings to pavement yet delivers nimble balance. They
break Formula 1® records, and are by far the most winning name
in the DTM (German Touring Car Championship). And they turn
victory on the track into vehicles that conquer the streets of
the world — and the hearts of its most passionate drivers.
IS WHAT IT CAN DO
If you’ve ever dreamed of merging a sports car with an SUV,
Mercedes-AMG has granted you three wishes. All of them join
the DNA of racing champions with high-performance hardware
and chiseled, muscular bodywork. The new AMG GLE 43 SUV10
pairs a 362-hp biturbo V6 with a paddle-shifted 9-speed to
reach 60 mph in 5.6 seconds.4 Its wheels and body are detailed
in bold gloss black. Lurking behind the twin-crosswing grille of
the 550-hp AMG GLE 63 and 577-hp GLE 63 S are handcrafted
biturbo V8s. Each conspires with an AMG SPEEDSHIFT® PLUS
7G-TRONIC transmission to hit 60 in as little as 4.1 seconds,
while they embrace you in supple Exclusive Nappa leather. All
three super-SUVs send torrents of torque to their 20" or 21"
AMG® wheels with precisely metered precision: the teamwork
of AMG Performance 4matic, an AMG Sport Suspension based
on AIRMATIC,® and the multimode AMG DYNAMIC SELECT.

DYNAMIC SELECT
A M O D E F O R
A N Y R O A D
No matter what you’re taking on — from challenging roads to cargo loads, the GLE is eager to
adapt. With just a twist of its DYNAMIC SELECT knob, you can reconfigure its drivetrain and
chassis settings to suit the situation, the season, the surface of the road — or your state of mind.
With up to 80.3 cubic feet of cargo room,11 a GLE fulfills
your desire for a versatile SUV before you even leave
your driveway. But whatever you’re carrying, wherever
you’re climbing, or whenever the road or weather
changes, the DYNAMIC SELECT system puts the GLE’s
many dimensions of driving character at your fingertips.
With a turn of a console control, DYNAMIC SELECT’s
multiple modes fine-tune the powertrain and chassis
to suit your needs. Three core programs — Comfort,
Sport and Slippery, plus an Individual mode you can set
